projectsList.title: AI Health Monitoring System
projectsList.description: Developed a comprehensive health monitoring platform using React, Python, and TensorFlow for medical data analysis and predictive analytics. Implemented real-time data processing, machine learning algorithms for health predictions, and interactive dashboards for healthcare professionals.

projectsList.title: Blockchain Voting Platform
projectsList.description: Built a secure, transparent voting system on Ethereum blockchain with smart contract verification and real-time results. Features include voter authentication, immutable vote recording, and real-time election monitoring with fraud detection capabilities.

projectsList.title: E-Learning Platform
projectsList.description: Created an interactive learning platform with real-time collaboration features and AI-powered content recommendations. Implemented video conferencing, interactive quizzes, progress tracking, and personalized learning paths for 5000+ students.

projectsList.title: Smart City Dashboard
projectsList.description: Developed an IoT-based dashboard for urban planning and environmental monitoring using Next.js, Python, and D3.js. Integrated real-time sensor data, traffic analysis, and predictive modeling for city management.

projectsList.title: Fintech Mobile Application
projectsList.description: Built a mobile banking application with biometric authentication, real-time transactions, and AI-powered financial insights. Implemented secure payment processing, budget tracking, and personalized financial recommendations.
